name: Nurse Life Coloring Book of Funny, Snarky Quotes
seoTitle: Funny Snarky Nurse Quotes Coloring Book
metaDescription: An adult coloring book with 30+ funny, snarky, and motivational nursing quotes. A lighthearted Nurses Week gift for RNs who love dark humor.
summary: More than 30 funny, snarky, and motivational nursing quotes to color. A lighthearted Nurses Week gift for the RN with a sharp sense of humor.
whyItWorks: Nurse humor has its own flavor. It is a little sarcastic, a little dark, and usually born from the kind of shifts that would be hard to explain at a dinner party. A coloring book that mixes snarky lines with motivational ones respects both sides of the job, the eye rolls and the reasons they keep showing up.

There are more than 30 quotes inside, enough for a few weeks of evening coloring or a long stretch of quiet time on a day off. It fits well in a Nurses Week basket with candy, lip balm, and a good pen, or as a gift from one nurse to another who shares the same humor. Some nurses even keep a book like this in a locker for lunch breaks, when a few minutes of coloring is easier than scrolling. Because the tone is snarky, it is best for someone you know appreciates a bit of edge.
goodToKnow: The title describes the quotes as funny and snarky, so preview the listing if the recipient prefers gentle humor.
Coloring supplies are not included in the title, so add a pencil set.
A good fit for a nurse to nurse gift between friends on the same unit.

faq.q: Is this appropriate for a coworker you do not know well?
faq.a: Snarky humor varies, so it is safest for someone whose sense of humor you know. Check the listing preview to see the tone.

faq.q: Is this a good Nurses Week gift?
faq.a: Yes, it is a fun, budget friendly addition to a Nurses Week basket or a small standalone thank you.
